version.author: A-intheCode
version.changelog: + v2.0.10: Release v2.0.10 - Staccato rendering on all selected notes, auto-chase pre-staccato restoration, slur legato playback, and note audition accuracy + v2.0.7: Official Production Release - Clean Note Audition, Static Canvas Focus, MusicXML Performance Engine, Multi-Monitor 4K HiDPI Maximize & Native 60-144 FPS Timer: - Suppress '● REC' Badge During Note Audition / Preview ('modules/services/audio_preview.lua', 'modules/rendering/score_canvas.lua', 'modules/ui/record_modal.lua' & 'modules/services/record_quantize_service.lua'): Added 'AudioPreview.is_track_user_armed(track)' to distinguish genuine user record-arming from temporary 'StuffMIDIMessage' Virtual MIDI Keyboard preview arming ('AudioPreview.track_restore'). Clicking or dragging notes to audition them no longer displays the red '● REC' pill badge or red recording border on the instrument track header. - No Canvas Movement or Focus Jump on Note Click Unless Auto-Scroll Is Active ('modules/rendering/score_canvas.lua', 'modules/input/mouse_handler.lua', 'modules/services/midi_service.lua' & 'modules/state.lua'): Clicking notes, item badges, clefs, or track headers on the ScoreCanvas now synchronizes 'last_reaper_sel_item' and 'last_reaper_sel_track' immediately and suppresses 'jump_to_item', keeping the ScoreCanvas viewport ('scroll_x' / 'scroll_y') completely stationary unless 'Auto-Scroll' ('state.auto_scroll') is explicitly enabled. - MusicXML Slur & Tie Rendering Optimization ('modules/services/slur_service.lua'): Eliminated the 8 FPS bottleneck in dense orchestral MusicXML scores (e.g. Bars 40-49 with dozens of slurs and 200+ ties) by introducing a per-frame spatial/pitch index ('get_note_render_index' with 'by_pitch', 'min_qn'/'max_qn' culling, and cached 'resolved_ties'/'resolved_slurs'), memoized GUID normalization ('_norm_guid_cache'), and direct MediaTrack pointer comparisons (removing ~200,000 'ValidatePtr'/'GetTrackGUID' C-API calls and ~1.5M table iterations per frame). - Cached Key & Time Signature Resolution ('modules/services/key_signature_service.lua' & 'modules/services/midi_service.lua'): Added take-level caches ('_take_time_events_cache', '_item_pext_time_cache') and precomputed 'evt.qn' values for all 'NOTATOR_KEY' and 'NOTATOR_TIME_SIG' text events, eliminating ~25,000 C-API calls ('MIDI_CountEvts', 'MIDI_GetTextSysexEvt', 'MIDI_GetPPQPosFromProjQN') and ~50,000 regex matches per frame. - Mid-Piece MusicXML Time Signature Timeline Sync & Orphaned Metadata Cleanup ('modules/services/tempo_service.lua' & 'modules/services/musicxml_import_service.lua'): Synchronizes mid-piece 'NOTATOR_TIME_SIG' changes from MIDI takes directly to REAPER's master timeline via 'SetTempoTimeSigMarker', prunes orphaned legacy 'ProjExtState' ties/key signatures on import and project load, and scopes unguided legacy ties to prevent cross-track duplication. - Multi-Monitor & 4K HiDPI Window Maximize Fix ('reaper_native_notator.lua'): Removed 'ImGui_GetMainViewport' fallback (which returned REAPER's main window on the 1080p monitor instead of the Notator's target 4K display), replaced hardcoded '1280x720' (16:9) limits with monitor-proportional bounds, and added live OS HWND coordinate-space calibration ('JS_Window_GetRect' vs ReaImGui logical window state + Stage 3 post-maximize verification) so maximizing fills 100% of any monitor (4K laptop + 1080p external display) regardless of Windows DPI scaling (100%-250%). - Native Win32 0x29a Timer Bridge ('modules/bin/notator_timer_x64.dll' & 'modules/services/frame_timer_service.lua'): Unlocks REAPER's hardcoded 30ms (~32.0 FPS) global 'reaper.defer()' and ReaImGui timer ceiling on Windows. Synchronizes REAPER's '0x29a' main-window timer at 1ms kernel precision with 'Target Framerate (FPS)' (15, 30, 60, 90, 120, 144, Uncapped) while REAPER Notator is open, and automatically restores REAPER's default 30ms timer upon closing ('atexit' + 800ms auto-shutoff watchdog). - Eliminated ReaImGui Frame-Skip Desynchronization: Driven natively by the OS timer at the target framerate instead of skipping 'ImGui_Begin' frames inside 'defer', keeping ReaImGui's 'Resource::Timer::tick()' and 'keepAlive' lifecycle 100% synchronized on every tick. - Framerate-Independent Reaticulate Sync Polling: Converted 'poll_reaticulate_sync' from tick-counting to real-time seconds ('reaper.time_precise()') so bank compilation polling behaves identically at 30, 60, 90, or 144 FPS. - Reaticulate Primary Bank Replacement Without Stacking (v2.0.4): Adding or changing an articulation bank on a track now deletes the top primary bank ('appdata.banks[1]') and any conflicting Omni ('src == 17') or duplicate entries in 'P_EXT:reaticulate' before loading the new bank, and guards against Reaticulate's 'rfx.gc()' overwriting 'P_EXT:reaticulate' with stale uncommitted UI state, preventing duplicate stacked banks and program number conflict errors in Reaticulate. - Insert Articulations at Edit Cursor in Empty Selected MIDI Items (v2.0.4): Articulations can now be inserted directly at the Edit Cursor inside a selected MIDI item even when the item contains 0 notes (or no note at the cursor position). 'auto_chase_momentary_articulations' now preserves standalone user-placed Program Change / Bank Select events on empty takes, and 'ScoreCanvas' visibly renders all standalone articulations above the staff when no note exists at that position yet. - Automatic MIDI Item Selection on Note Selection (v2.0.4): Selecting a note (via click, right-click, marquee selection, or keyboard navigation) now automatically selects its parent MIDI item in both REAPER Notator ('state.selected_item' / 'state.selected_take') and REAPER's arrange timeline ('SetMediaItemSelected'). Clicking inside an empty MIDI item on the staff to place the Edit Cursor also selects that MIDI item. - Top-Bar Version Display Hotfix (v2.0.3): Synchronized 'modules/version.lua' with automatic '-- @version' header verification and 'package.loaded["version"]' cache clearing on script reload. - Expanded User Manual, PDF Documentation & Codebase Statistics (v2.0.3): Updated 'docs/user_manual.md', 'docs/reaper_notator_user_manual.pdf', 'docs/codebase_statistics.md', 'docs/reaper_notator_codebase_statistics.pdf', 'README.md', and the in-app Help Modal with comprehensive documentation for the Transport Recording & Auto-Quantize Suite as well as the Automatic Reaticulate FX Slot 1 Setup & Bank Sync on new tracks. - Automatic Reaticulate FX Slot 1 Setup & P_EXT Bank Sync (v2.0.2): Selecting a bank in the Bank Picker or applying an articulation on a new/unconfigured track now automatically verifies that 'JS:Reaticulate' ('Reaticulate.jsfx') is loaded on the track, places/moves it to the very first FX slot (Slot 1 / index 0, before any VSTi instrument), writes the bank assignment into 'P_EXT:reaticulate', resolves/allocates project MSB/LSB ('CC0'/'CC32') for 'Bank * *' definitions, and syncs with Reaticulate. - Reliable Articulation Insertion at Selected Notes & Edit Cursor (v2.0.2): Fixed missing 'CC0'/'CC32' Bank Select events on wildcard banks, automatic bank override resolution across all MidiService articulation helpers, and direct attachment of 'NOTE <pitch> <chan> a <art>' + Bank Select + Program Change to notes at the Edit Cursor when no notes are explicitly selected. - 2-Step Window Maximize & Startup Centering Fix (v2.0.1): Removed 'ImGui_GetWindowViewport' (which returned the window's own size instead of the monitor size). On both REAPER startup and Maximize toggle, REAPER Notator now strictly reads the maximum possible screen work area of the target monitor first, places the window in small size in the exact center of the screen, and then scales up to full screen when maximizing. 'is_maximized' is no longer persisted across sessions so every startup opens cleanly centered. - Unified ReaPack Release & Fault-Tolerant Module Loading (v2.0.0): Promoted to official v2.0.x release so all ReaPack users automatically receive the complete module suite ('ui.record_modal', 'services.record_quantize_service', 'ui.filter_irregular_modal') upon synchronizing packages, with safe module fallbacks and removal of deprecated legacy versions so outdated releases can no longer be installed. - Collapsed Window & Legacy ExtState Cleanup on Startup: Added 'ImGui_WindowFlags_NoCollapse' and 'ImGui_SetNextWindowCollapsed(ctx, false)' to prevent double-clicking the title bar from shading/collapsing the window into an unresponsive state in ReaImGui's .ini file. Automatically purges legacy pre-v2 physical window coordinates from reaper-extstate.ini and removes obsolete temporary files on startup. - Single-Pass Startup Optimization & Non-Blocking Version Detection: Eliminated redundant 3x full-project MIDI scans on Frame 1, added fast-path Type-15 text event checks before take reconciliation, and replaced synchronous 'reaper.ExecProcess(git ...)' at startup with pure-Lua .git/HEAD inspection. - Custom & Navigation Rehearsal Mark Drag-and-Drop Fix: Custom Markers and Navigation Marks (e.g. 'D.C.', 'D.C. al Fine') permanently retain their name across moves, with dynamic badge hitboxes and grid-snapped dragging. - Inline Double-Click Renaming & Auto-Sequence Exclusion: Double-clicking any Rehearsal Mark on the score canvas (or using '✏ Rename Mark' in the right-click menu / Tools Drawer) opens an inline rename box. Renaming any mark locks it as a Custom Marker and automatically excludes it from the A, B, C... / 1, 2, 3... counting sequence. - Custom Marker Shortcut ('Ctrl+M') During Live Playback & Stopped: Added configurable shortcut 'Add Custom Rehearsal Marker' (default: Ctrl+M) that places sequential default markers ('Marker 1', 'Marker 2', 'Marker 3'...) both when stopped (at Edit Cursor) and live during Playback/Recording at the exact Playhead position snapped to the active Notation Grid. - Track Header 'REC' Pill Badge Alignment & Sizing Fix: Crisp vector circle ('ImGui_DrawList_AddCircleFilled') and dynamically sized red pill background around 'REC' with automatic track title truncation. - 'Snap to Grid' Option for Notes Outside Tick Range: Added '🧲 Snap to Grid' ('snap', now default) alongside 'Keep natural', 'Delete outliers', and 'Move to Voice 16' under 'Notes outside tolerance:' in the Record Modal. - Live & Post-Record Auto-Quantize Engine: Real-time non-destructive auto-quantize preview on the ScoreCanvas during MIDI recording, keyboard bounce elimination (<15 ticks), same-pitch overlap trimming, and clean take commit upon stopping. - Bidirectional REAPER Track Arming & MIDI Input Selector: Arm/disarm any REAPER track directly from the right-click Record Modal with automatic MIDI Overdub (I_RECMODE = 7), input monitoring, and hardware/virtual MIDI input device & channel selection. - Filter Irregular Notes Feature: Dedicated modal dialog under Tools Drawer to detect and isolate unquantized/humanized recorded MIDI notes with adjustable tolerance (0-50 ticks), triplet detection, yellow score canvas highlight preview, and regular note ghosting. - Polyphonic Rest Consolidation & Gould Compliance: Centered shared rests for simultaneous rests across voices, inactive voice rest suppression, and strict cross-voice note collision prevention. - Multi-Monitor Window Position & Maximization Persistence: Saves and restores window coordinates, dimensions, monitor target, and maximization state across sessions with HiDPI scaling support.

version.name: 2.0.10-beta
version.author: A-intheCode
version.changelog: + v2.0.10-beta: v2.0.10-beta: Fix MidiService.is_momentary_articulation call and staccato auto-chase + v2.0.9-beta: v2.0.9-beta: Fix staccato dots on all selected/marked notes and immediate return to pre-staccato articulation + v2.0.8-beta: Hotfix - Slur Legato/Long Playback, Right-Panel Default Slur Dropdown & Note Preview Articulation Accuracy: - Slur Legato / Long Playback & Auto-Heal ('modules/services/slur_service.lua', 'modules/services/midi_service.lua' & 'modules/services/reaticulate_parser.lua'): Fixed 'ReaticulateParser.get_bank_for_track' to resolve user-assigned banks from 'state.track_articulation_banks', separated 'get_default_base_articulation' (strictly Long/Sustain, never Legato) from 'find_slur_articulation_in_bank', and updated 'auto_chase_momentary_articulations' and 'load_slurs' to automatically verify and insert the Slur start Program Change ('CC0 + CC32 + PC') and post-slur chase restoration so slurs reliably trigger Legato (or Long fallback) in Reaticulate. - Right-Panel 'Default Slur:' Behavior Dropdown ('modules/ui/articulations_drawer.lua', 'modules/state.lua' & 'modules/services/midi_service.lua'): Added a per-track 'Default Slur:' dropdown directly below the Slur / Tie / Portamento / Glissando buttons in the Articulations Drawer with 'Auto (Legato -> Long)' (default priority cascade: searches Legato first, falls back to Long / Sustain if the bank has no Legato), 'Legato', 'Long / Sustain', and direct selection of any Legato/Long patch from the active Reaticulate bank. - Note Click Preview ('AudioPreview') Articulation Accuracy ('modules/services/audio_preview.lua' & 'modules/rendering/score_canvas.lua'): Fixed 'AudioPreview.find_active_articulation_at_qn' so clicking any note auditions the exact articulation active at that note in the MIDI item (including slurred notes, note-attached articulations, and prior standalone Program Changes such as 'trill m2' at Bar 1 Beat 1) instead of defaulting to 'legato', and ensured a clean 45ms settling window between Program Change ('0xC0') and 'Note On' ('0x90'). - Suppress '● REC' Badge During Note Audition / Preview (v2.0.7, 'modules/services/audio_preview.lua', 'modules/rendering/score_canvas.lua', 'modules/ui/record_modal.lua' & 'modules/services/record_quantize_service.lua'): Added 'AudioPreview.is_track_user_armed(track)' to distinguish genuine user record-arming from temporary 'StuffMIDIMessage' Virtual MIDI Keyboard preview arming ('AudioPreview.track_restore'). - No Canvas Movement or Focus Jump on Note Click Unless Auto-Scroll Is Active (v2.0.7, 'modules/rendering/score_canvas.lua', 'modules/input/mouse_handler.lua', 'modules/services/midi_service.lua' & 'modules/state.lua'): Clicking notes, item badges, clefs, or track headers on the ScoreCanvas now synchronizes 'last_reaper_sel_item' and 'last_reaper_sel_track' immediately and suppresses 'jump_to_item'.
